parole.testo: From the root ח־ו־ה or ח־י־ה as either the only remnant of a hishtaph'el binyan (compare the Arabic cognate binyan Form X استفعل (istaf’ala), which remains highly productive in Arabic)—in which case cognate with Ugaritic 𐎅𐎌𐎚𐎈𐎆𐎊 (hštḥwy)—or borrowed from the Ugaritic word.
